description: CallGraphComponent currently names only a canonical FunctionId; strong_component computes members transiently. A canonical recursive-return group must enumerate precisely the ActivationKeys whose functions belong to its component without a World scan, and must retract membership exactly when either an activation or component edge moves. Retain one fact-owned, incremental component-to-activation membership authority after fz-kdt.98.3 makes CallGraphComponent complete. TDD: equal replay performs no work; an unrelated activation/component changes no other component inventory; relevant activation add/remove or component rebase moves only exact membership and readers; FIFO/LIFO/permuted admissions produce identical membership. Required before fz-kdt.177.9 can publish one exact return derivation per member.
title: Retain exact component activation membership
